Create a new package (Admin only). Validates that serviceId references an active service.

request.description: List packages with optional filters: active, serviceId (Admin only). Returns 400 if serviceId not found or inactive.
Get a single package by ID (Admin only). Returns 404 if not found or inactive.
Update a package by ID (Admin only). Validates serviceId if provided.
Reactivate a deactivated package by ID (Admin only). Returns 204 No Content.
Soft delete (deactivate) a package by ID (Admin only). Returns 204 No Content.
Create a new unit (Admin only). Name must be unique.
List all units ordered by name (Admin only)
Get a unit by ID (Admin only)
Update a unit by ID (Admin only). Name uniqueness checked when changed.
Hard delete a unit by ID (Admin only). Returns 204 No Content.
Add a new card (Client only). Requires gateway token from payment provider. Frontend tokenizes card via gateway SDK.
List all cards for the authenticated client (Client only)
Remove a card by ID (Client only). Returns 204 No Content.
Set a card as default (Client only). Unsets all other defaults first.
Sync holidays from BrasilAPI + RJ state/municipal + pontos facultativos for a given year
List all holidays, optionally filtered by year
Get a holiday by its ID
Create a holiday manually. isBlocked controls whether it blocks scheduling.
Update a holiday (name, date, or isBlocked toggle)
Hard delete a holiday by ID
Create a new appointment (Admin only). Date must be a weekday and not a holiday. Duration max 480 min.
List appointments with optional filters (Admin only). Supports date, week range, employee, unit, status, and pagination.
Get an appointment by ID (Admin only). Returns full appointment with client, service, employee, package, and unit relations.
Update an appointment by ID (Admin only). All fields optional except clientId (immutable).
Reschedule an appointment (Admin only). Creates a new SCHEDULED appointment linked via rescheduledFromId and cancels the original.
Cancel an appointment (Admin only). Only SCHEDULED appointments can be cancelled. Returns 204 No Content.
Mark an appointment as completed (Admin only). Returns updated appointment with COMPLETED status.
Create a new appointment (Client only). clientId is extracted from JWT token. Date must be a weekday and not a holiday.
List authenticated client's appointments with pagination (Client only).
Get an appointment by ID (Client only). Only returns appointments belonging to the authenticated client.
Reschedule own appointment (Client only). Creates a new SCHEDULED appointment and cancels the original.
Cancel own appointment (Client only). Only SCHEDULED appointments can be cancelled. Returns 204 No Content.
List payments with optional filters: status, method, clientId, dateFrom, dateTo, pagination (Admin only).
Get a payment by ID (Admin only). Returns full payment with client, appointment, and card relations.
Approve a pending payment (Admin only). Only PENDING payments can be approved. Sets paidAt timestamp.
Delete a payment by ID (Admin only). Returns 204 No Content.
Create a payment for an appointment (Client only). Methods: PIX, CREDIT_CARD, DEBIT_CARD. Card payments require cardId. Recurrence discounts: 10% weekly/biweekly, 5% monthly.
List authenticated client's payments with pagination and optional status filter (Client only).
Get a payment by ID (Client only). Only returns payments belonging to the authenticated client.
Vindi payment gateway webhook. Handles bill_paid, charge_rejected, and bill_canceled events. No auth required.
